top_signals.title: Goldman Sounds Out Investors for CoreWeave-Tied Data Center Bond
top_signals.summary: Goldman Sachs Group Inc. is sounding out investor interest on a junk bond to fund construction of a data center leased to CoreWeave Inc., adding to a wave of borrowing tied to the neocloud firm as it seeks to capitalize on the artificial intelligence boom.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
